sectionTitle: ANYTHING ELSE I NEED TO KNOW?

items.question: How safe is Cambodia?
items.answer: We felt very safe in Cambodia. We walked around Siem Reap past 10:00 PM and took a few inner lanes to our venues. They were more rustic than the tourist traps, but they also felt safe.

items.question: Is English commonly understood?
items.answer: At least in Siem Reap, the answer is yes.

items.question: What could ruin my stay in Cambodia?
items.answer: Depending on when you go, the weather may play spoilsport—especially on sunset tours, because evening showers are more common.
